name: Blue snakeweed
desc: Blue snakeweed (Stachytarpheta cayennensis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 15 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Stachytarpheta cayennensis is a species of flowering plant in the verbena family known by many English language common names, including blue snakeweed, Cayenne snakeweed, dark-blue snakeweed,…
